whatThisIs: [Breastfeeding and Returning to Work is one resource page that goes over state and federal laws about rights for returning breastfeeding employees. The website as a whole contains resources and information aimed at connecting breastfeeding families to local support, information regarding state and federal law of breastfeeding in the workplace, along with their overall mission of advocacy and education for breastfeeding.]
whoItHelps: People and families looking for an overview of state and federal law for returning employees
People looking for more information about how the returning to work process may look like while breastfeeding
People interesting in learning more about advocacy work for breastfeeding in Massachusetts
whatToKnow: Massachusetts Breastfeeding Coalition was founded in 1999 as a 501c(3) non-profit. This website services as both a resource page and page of contact for their collation and the work they do in the community with its partners.
name: Breastfeeding and Returning to Work
